observation: GSK-3beta hyperactivated in Wwox-null mice; lithium abolishes PTZ seizures
relation_hypothesised: GSK-3beta hyperactivation contributes to WWOX seizures
possible_action: Lithium now; selective GSK-3beta inhibitor as follow-up
benefit_to_verify: Reduced spontaneous seizures and developmental, EEG and myelination endpoints
favourable_reason: Only existing-drug node with preclinical support
unfavourable_or_alternative: Provoked model, non-selective drug, no human data; lithium effect could be off-target
discriminating_experiment: Selective inhibitor against spontaneous seizures in Wwox-null or conditional mice with co-measured development and myelination
reasoning_pattern: A drug that blocks a model phenotype is taken to implicate the node it is known to inhibit

observation: Wwox-KO neocortical bursting is NMDAR- and gap-junction-dependent
relation_hypothesised: Glutamatergic NMDAR/AMPA drive underlies WWOX epileptogenesis
context: Mouse neocortical slice or culture, layer II/III neurons
benefit_to_verify: Reduced bursting, then spontaneous seizures and E/I balance
favourable_reason: Approved drugs with matching receptor targets
unfavourable_or_alternative: Slice readout without in vivo validation; AMPA dependence not shown; no gap-junction drug named
discriminating_experiment: Apply felbamate or perampanel to the bursting readout and test spontaneous seizures in WWOX-KO systems
reasoning_pattern: An in-vitro receptor dependence is matched to an approved drug of the same receptor class

observation: VABAM seen in two WWOX children on vigabatrin; authors ask about GABAergic or delayed-myelination susceptibility
relation_hypothesised: WWOX myelination or GABAergic phenotype may increase vigabatrin imaging toxicity
possible_action: Avoid or monitor vigabatrin; prospective MRI
context: Human infants with WWOX variants on vigabatrin
benefit_to_verify: Fewer MRI abnormalities; none claimed for efficacy
unfavourable_or_alternative: Only 2 cases; vigabatrin also gave the only sustained response; VABAM occurs in non-WWOX infants
discriminating_experiment: Prospective MRI series of vigabatrin-exposed WWOX children against other genetic DEE controls
reasoning_pattern: A safety signal in a small series is linked to the genotype by a plausible pathway shared with the authors' generic hypothesis

observation: AAV9-WWOX in neonatal Wwox-null mice rescues seizures, myelination, hypoglycemia, survival
relation_hypothesised: Root-cause restoration rescues both seizures and development
benefit_to_verify: Developmental and survival rescue beyond seizure control
favourable_reason: Broad preclinical rescue, dose-dependent and durable
unfavourable_or_alternative: Mouse lifespan of weeks; human translation, timing and dose unknown; not an antiseizure drug
discriminating_experiment: Uncouple remyelination from WWOX restoration; define delivery parameters and biomarkers
reasoning_pattern: A mouse rescue by restoring the lost gene is read as the preferred route for the human disease

observation: CBD and fenfluramine are credited with non-seizure benefits in other DEEs
relation_hypothesised: Direct CNS effects improve alertness, sleep, communication independent of seizures
possible_action: Pilot CBD or fenfluramine with QoL endpoints in WWOX-DEE
context: Human DEEs (uncontrolled, caregiver-reported); WWOX not studied
benefit_to_verify: QoL measures independent of seizure count
favourable_reason: Benefit reported across many studies; not dependent on seizure reduction
unfavourable_or_alternative: No WWOX mechanism; open-label and reporting bias; no WWOX data
discriminating_experiment: Pilot with QoL endpoints (alertness, communication, sleep, caregiver burden) independent of seizure count
reasoning_pattern: A benefit seen in other disorders of the same class is extrapolated to the genotype by class membership

observation: Delay precedes seizures; all drug-resistant; one responsive case still worsened
relation_hypothesised: Seizure reduction does not drive development in WWOX-DEE
unfavourable_or_alternative: n = 1 responder; narrative outcomes; milder genotypes untested; absence of opportunity
discriminating_experiment: Registry with Bayley/Vineland time-locked to video-EEG, stratified by genotype and SCAR12 vs WOREE
reasoning_pattern: Temporal precedence plus lack of a positive report is read as independence of two features

observation: KCNQ2 DEE and surgical infantile spasms show seizure freedom without developmental gain; cryptogenic IS and TSC show the link
relation_hypothesised: Developmental outcome tracks etiology; WWOX-DEE belongs to the fixed-substrate group
context: Other genetic DEEs, infantile spasms, TSC
unfavourable_or_alternative: Different diseases and ages; no head-to-head comparison; baseline-severity confounding
discriminating_experiment: Compare within-WWOX responders and nonresponders in the registry against KCNQ2 cohorts
reasoning_pattern: A pattern from neighbouring disorders is transferred to the genotype by phenotype similarity
